full_prompt_en: A square figurative oil painting shows a young man reclining in a green armchair inside a crowded domestic room. He wears a rust-red buttoned tunic and matching loose trousers tucked into tall black boots. One booted leg extends toward the lower left, while his hands rest heavily on the chair arms. His closely cut hair and direct, serious gaze bring a still focal point to the busy setting. On the wooden floor beside the chair, a broad brown dog lies with its forepaws stretched toward the viewer, looking outward. A vivid teal door or screen rises behind them on the right. To the left, the room is filled with framed pictures, a large pale ceramic vessel, a patterned cloth and a low table holding smaller objects. These surrounding details are visible but loosely organized, leaving the seated figure and dog as the clearest forms. Red-brown clothing occupies the center, framed by cool green chair upholstery and turquoise woodwork. Warm cream and pale blue gray notes break up the room beyond. Soft daylight enters from the left, bringing moderate brightness to the face, uniform and dog, while folds and the space below the chair hold cool dark shadow. The paint uses short, visible touches that make fabric, wood and framed surfaces tactile without dissolving the figures. Contours remain firm around the hands, boots and dog, then loosen among the background objects. The composition is intimate and slightly informal, with the long diagonal of the legs balanced by the low horizontal animal. The whole room feels lived in, its dense detail held together by the strong red-green color opposition.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形人物油画呈现一名年轻男子斜倚在拥挤家居房间的一把绿色扶手椅中。他穿纽扣锈红上衣和同色宽松裤子，裤脚收进高黑靴。一条穿靴的腿伸向左下，双手沉稳地放在椅子扶手上。短发和直视画外的严肃目光，为繁忙环境带来静止焦点。椅旁木地板上，一只宽厚棕狗卧着，前爪伸向观者，也向外看。鲜明青绿色门板或屏风在他们后方的右边升起。左边，房间里摆满画框、大型浅色陶罐、花纹布和放有小物件的矮桌。周围细节仍可见，却安排得较松，使坐姿人物和狗成为最清楚的形体。红褐衣服占据中央，被冷绿椅面和青绿木结构框住。暖奶油色与浅蓝灰色碎点打破后面的房间。柔日光从左边进入，让面孔、制服和狗适度明亮，褶皱及椅下空间则留着冷暗阴影。颜料使用短而可见的笔触，使布料、木头和画框表面可触，又没有溶解人物形体。手、靴和狗周围的轮廓坚实，到背景物件之间则放松。构图亲近且略显随意，双腿的长斜线由较低的动物水平线平衡。整个房间有生活气息，繁密细节被强烈红绿对照连在一起。
style_prompt_en: The image has a tactile oil-painted surface formed by short visible strokes and carefully organized blocks of muted color. Rust red carries a dominant central mass, opposed by cool teal and green fields and smaller cream highlights. Forms are solidly modeled but not smoothed into photographic finish; pigment remains active across fabric, wood and surrounding texture. Edges stay clear around the main near shapes and loosen amid denser peripheral detail. A seated diagonal and a low horizontal counterweight create a relaxed but stable rhythm. Soft side light gives moderate volume and localized brightness, while darker recesses gather below overlapping forms. The background is busy and layered, yet its lower contrast keeps the central color opposition legible. Perspective is intimate, with nearby floor and furnishings occupying substantial area and little distant vista. The overall effect is grounded, warm and lived in, joining direct observation to patterned, hand-worked surfaces.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有可触的油画表面，由短而可见的笔触与有序的低饱和色块构成。锈红形成占主导的中央团块，与冷青绿、绿色域及少量奶油亮点相对。形体塑得坚实，却没有抹成摄影般光滑的表面；颜料在布料、木面及周围肌理里保持活跃。主要近处形体周围的边缘清楚，较密的外围细节中则放松。坐姿斜线和低位水平重量形成松弛但稳定的节奏。柔和侧光赋予适度体积和局部亮度，较深凹影聚在重叠形体下方。背景繁忙且有层次，但较低对比让中央冷暖色对抗仍然清楚。透视亲近，附近地面与陈设占据相当面积，没有宽远风景。整体效果落地、温暖且有生活痕迹，把直接观察与带纹样感、手工加工的表面接在一起。
theme_en: A man in a rust-red uniform rests in a green chair with a brown dog on the floor of a decorated room
theme_zh: 一名穿锈红制服的男子坐在绿色椅中休息，棕狗卧于装饰繁多的房间地板上
name: Kuzma Petrov-Vodkin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
